categories.name: Chest
categories.description: Chest training primarily targets the pectoralis major and minor. It is essential for upper body pushing strength.
categories.howTo: Keep shoulder blades retracted. Control the weight during the descent and exhale as you push.
categories.benefit: Improved pushing power and better posture.

categories.name: Back
categories.description: Back training involves the latissimus dorsi and rhomboids. A strong back protects your spine.
categories.howTo: Pull with your elbows rather than your hands. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the peak.
categories.benefit: Creates a strong frame and balances posture.

categories.name: Legs
categories.description: Leg day covers the quads and glutes. These are the largest muscles in the body.
categories.howTo: Keep feet flat and core tight. Ensure your knees stay in line with your toes.
categories.benefit: Massive functional strength and high calorie burn.

categories.name: Cardio
categories.description: Cardio training improves cardiovascular health and endurance.
categories.howTo: Maintain a steady pace that elevates your heart rate.
